newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Eleven police Special Task Force commandos missing after clash with Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) separatists (LTTE) in eastern Ampara.
Police arrest seven LTTE rebels sent to attack the president's official residence in Nuwara Eliya in the central hills, police sources say.

Working with the media is more difficult than dealing with telephones, says Mangala Samaraweera, the new Minister of Media and Telecommunications. Samaraweera was given the media portfolio in this month's cabinet reshuffle.
United Nations Development Programme says Sri Lanka is definitely in a position where it can move forward economically over the next decade and thereby drastically reduce its poverty levels.
Sri Lanka Navy yet to take delivery of special vessels from an European country, much needed to fight increasing threats from Sea Tigers, the LTTE's naval wing, sources said.
